name: stored-versions-refused-before-request
description: A check of 64 specs, the most one request names, is answered; one of 65 specs, one of no target and one whose recipe reads a frame DFO computed raise InvalidRequestError invalid_argument and send no request.

origin.edit: The steps and exchanges are a check of 64 specs, answered 200, then checks of 65 specs, of no target and of a recipe reading the answer's derived frame.
